'''Blade''', previous name {{Lang|'''Yingxing'''|zh=应星}}, is a playable [[character]] in ''[[Honkai: Star Rail]]''.

A member of the [[Stellaron Hunters]] and a swordsman who abandoned his body to become a blade. He pledges loyalty to [[Elio|Destiny's Slave]] and possesses a terrifying self-healing ability.
